learning.title: Separate Deno read capability failures from kernel policy evidence
learning.trigger: A bounded diagnostic reports Deno NotCapable or an operating-system PermissionDenied result while reading fixed procfs, cgroup, or sysctl paths.
learning.rule: Deno run with --allow-read can still return NotCapable for fixed proc status, cgroup, or sysctl reads in a local environment. A diagnostic that combines NotCapable and operating-system PermissionDenied into one denied state cannot prove which capability or kernel policy caused the denial.

Preserve the existing capability boundary. When the distinction is required, use an explicitly authorized reader outside Deno that accepts only the fixed paths and bounded outputs needed for the observation.
learning.boundary: Do not add --allow-all, broaden path authority, infer a host kernel cause from the combined status, or weaken existing security assertions.
